verdicts.quote: the processor automatically evaluates positions 1, 2 and 3 at 09:00 billing-account local time on calendar days 1, 7 and 14 after the invoice due date.
drafts, canceled or voided invoices, invoices held from collection, and invoices with zero or negative balance produce zero dispatch initiations.
verdicts.missing: Credit notes, disputes and payment plans are not addressed; the dispute/hold status mapping is left as an open gap for the billing owner.

verdicts.quote: the intended recipient can identify the approved sender, invoice reference, due date and remaining balance with currency
missing, invalid, ambiguous or suppressed contact data withholds dispatch and exposes a safe reason.
verdicts.missing: Which customer-level do-not-contact/paused/unsubscribed states count as suppression, and whether a billing notice is exempt from a marketing opt-out (left to owners as 'suppression rules').

verdicts.quote: one account, invoice and schedule position identifies a logical reminder across overlapping executions and restarts... overlapping or stale workers cannot independently initiate a second handoff for that position

each new handoff, including a retry known to be safe, is authorized using current eligibility... a payment, void, collection hold... committed before dispatch authorization is effective for that authorization.
On a confirmed transient failure with proof of no handoff, allow a controlled retry within the same window... a permanent rejection closes the position as failed.
verdicts.missing: Retry intervals and limits are unresolved (NFR), and no escalation to a person after repeated failure is specified beyond billing support owning recovery of unknowns.

verdicts.quote: Throttling must preserve account isolation and replay protection and expose deferred or expired work. Invoice volumes, quotas, throughput and cost ceiling are unresolved.
verdicts.missing: The provider rate limit and how a large batch is paced within it.

verdicts.quote: Only positions with start times strictly after the current activation time qualify.
at 09:00 billing-account local time
